name: memory-loop
description: A memory lifecycle for Claude Code's native file-based memory: a save gate against hallucinated memories, tiered expiry (short-tier memories archived — never deleted — when they lapse), a propose-then-confirm consolidation pass (merge/dedupe long-tier memory), a correction-signal hook that logs likely corrections for the consolidate pass, a gated, budgeted habit frame (capture passes damage/recurrence/generality gates; the always-loaded rule file is capped at the write, with case records and retired rules on demand), and an optional identity setup (names for the user and the assistant). Local-only, English, no org-specific content.
